items.title: HeyGen
items.desc: Talking avatars and precise lip-sync from a single recording. The fastest way to see yourself on screen in another language.

items.title: Suno
items.desc: Full songs from a text prompt, including a cloned vocal persona. Useful for intros, jingles and branded audio.

items.title: Kling AI
items.desc: Short cinematic clips with strong physics and camera control. Good for B-roll when you have no footage.
